code_prompt_defaults.object_description_defense_wave: a retro space-shooter playfield with labeled or scored enemy ships, red downward enemy shots, blue upward player shots, a player ship, and bottom lane pads
code_prompt_defaults.space_shooter_lane_rule_text: Bottom lane pads define the vertical lanes. Enemy ships and shots stay in their own lane; red enemy shots move downward and blue player shots move upward.
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_clear_shot_score_value: set "annotation" to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every enemy ship contributing to the clear-shot score
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_clear_shot_score_value: set "answer" to the integer total score from clear-shot enemy ships
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_clear_shot_count: set "annotation" to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the enemy ships counted as clear shots
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_clear_shot_count: set "answer" to the number of enemy ships that have no enemy ship or blue player shot below them in the same lane
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_projectile_intercept_cou: set "annotation" to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for red enemy shots aligned with the player ship
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_projectile_intercept_count: set "answer" to the number of red enemy shots in the same lane as the player ship
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_highest_threat_label: set "annotation" to the selected enemy ship bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1]
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_highest_threat_label: set "answer" to the selected enemy label as a string
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_safe_lane_count: set "annotation" to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the safe bottom lane pads
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_safe_lane_count: set "answer" to the number of bottom lane pads with no red enemy shot in that lane
